# WPPlugins

> Automated, serverless WordPress.org SVN-to-GitHub plugin mirror covering 17,900+ WordPress plugins.

## Key URLs

- GitHub Organization: https://github.com/WPPlugins
- Mirror Orchestrator: https://github.com/WPPlugins/mirror-orchestrator
- Browse All Plugins (Paginated): https://wpplugins.github.io/plugins/
- Per-Plugin Mirror Page: `https://wpplugins.github.io/plugins/<slug>/`
- Per-Plugin Git Remote: `https://github.com/WPPlugins/<slug>.git`
- Extended AI Documentation: https://wpplugins.github.io/llms-full.txt
- Machine-Readable API Spec: https://wpplugins.github.io/openapi.json

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [Plugin Index JSON](https://wpplugins.github.io/data/plugins.json): Compact JSON array of `{ "s": slug, "d": description, "p": last_pushed_YYYY_MM_DD, "b": default_branch }`. Refreshed every 2 hours.
- [Index Stats JSON](https://wpplugins.github.io/data/stats.json): `{ "total_plugins": number, "generated_at": iso8601, "org": "WPPlugins" }`.
- [Sitemap Index](https://wpplugins.github.io/sitemap-index.xml): XML sitemap index covering directory pages and all mirrored plugin pages.

## Common Usage for Coding Agents

- **Clone a plugin:** `git clone https://github.com/WPPlugins/<slug>.git`
- **Add as Git submodule in WordPress:** `git submodule add https://github.com/WPPlugins/<slug>.git wp-content/plugins/<slug>`
- **Pin to a release tag:** `git fetch --tags && git checkout <version>` (Git tags match WordPress.org SVN `tags/*`).
- **Default branch:** Newer mirrors use `main`; some pre-orchestrator mirrors use `master` (check the `b` field in `/data/plugins.json`).
- **Constraints:** Mirrors are read-only. Individual files larger than 95 MB are skipped (logged in `WPPlugins/mirror-orchestrator`'s `state/oversized.json`).
